subject: President Ali Bongo's New Year's address
called_fake_by: Political opponents, including former rival candidate Bruno Ben Moubamba
claim: After months out of public view following medical treatment abroad, Bongo appeared stiff and unusual in a New Year's video. Critics said it was a deepfake hiding his true condition.
finding: Forensic analysis found no evidence the video was a deepfake. Experts said his appearance was most likely explained by illness, makeup and cosmetic work, though none could rule it out with total certainty.
outcome: About a week later, soldiers attempted a coup, citing doubts about the video. The coup failed within hours.

sources.title: The Bizarre and Terrifying Case of the "Deepfake" Video that Helped Bring an African Nation to the Brink
